"""Create a minimal historical run with original source identities, offline."""

import socket
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import judgmentllm
from judgmentllm.config import RunSpecV3
from judgmentllm.preparation import prepare_run
from judgmentllm.production_transport import production_context
from judgmentllm.providers import openai


def denied(*args, **kwargs):
    raise AssertionError("The historical producer must not use credentials or networking")


assert Path(judgmentllm.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve())
socket.socket = socket.getaddrinfo = socket.create_connection = denied
openai._sdk = openai._resolve_credentials = denied
cache = sys.argv[1]
assert cache in {"auto", "off"}
run_id = f"{cache}-minimal"
spec = RunSpecV3.model_validate_json(Path(f"{run_id}.json").read_bytes())
assert spec.capture == "minimal" and spec.execution.cache_policy == cache
with prepare_run(
    spec,
    store="in-place",
    run_id=run_id,
    capabilities=openai.OpenAIAdapter.capabilities_for("openai", "responses", spec.model),
    transport_context=production_context(spec),
) as prepared:
    assert "cache_policy_version" not in prepared.manifest.model_dump()
